review_scope: Generated native painting inspected inline at 1254 x 1254; no engine/collision/navigation validation.

checks.name: complete_large_town
checks.note: Whole original town remains edge-to-edge, northern temple, southern entrance, central plaza and connected side districts visible.

checks.name: original_layout_preserved
checks.note: Central north-south avenue, eastern river, four main eastern stone bridges and southern approach retained.

checks.name: spring_festival_mood
checks.note: Grouped red lanterns, knots, blank red hanging fabric, plum trees and paired decorative lion lanterns at southern entrance.

checks.name: regional_palette
checks.note: Slate-blue roof tiles, warm timber, pale stone, natural foliage and blue water retained. No uniform jade-green/gold roof palette.

checks.name: chibi_daoist_style
checks.note: Rounded miniature architecture, stout bridge forms, central yin-yang pattern and friendly hand-painted surfaces.

checks.name: road_readability
checks.note: Main roads, plazas, stairs and bridges appear broad and unobstructed. Requested 55% land openness is an art direction target, not a measured navigation ratio.

checks.name: no_people_or_ui
checks.note: No people, NPCs, UI, labels or watermark visible. Lion and rabbit forms are stationary festival decorations.

checks.name: native_output_preservation
checks.note: Original 1254x1254 PNG copied byte-for-byte. Only preview is downsampled.

limitations: Single flattened art image; not yet split into collision or foreground layers.
